summary.name: SkyReels
summary.one_liner: SkyReels is an AI video generation platform that creates cinematic videos with synchronized audio from text, images, or multimodal references.
use_cases: generate cinematic clips from text prompts
animate still images with camera movement
create short story videos with sound
summary.what_it_does: The page describes SkyReels V4 as a tool that generates videos from text descriptions, images, or reference inputs. Text to Video turns a prompt into a video with motion and sound. Image to Video adds natural motion and camera movement to still images. Omni Reference to Video uses image, video, and audio references to control characters, style, and story across scenes. The page also mentions smarter shot transitions for sequences across multiple shots.
notable: Generates video and audio together in one pass
Omni Reference accepts image, video, and audio references
Camera control and shot transitions for multi-shot sequences
caveats: Pricing tiers and limits are not detailed on the page; the freemium label comes from the directory listing
